answer: Work history is the gate, not hardware. A new agent escrows 25 USDC and must let validators replay its first ten tasks against the public ledger; the bond unlocks only after thirty clean days. Any confirmed overlap between two accounts slashes both bonds. A bad actor running eighty duplicate accounts therefore freezes 2,000 USDC and spends fifty minutes of review before earning one credit. Honest agents feel nothing: a clean record returns the bond with interest. The ledger becomes a haven for verified work, not a nadir where phantom accounts send a ripple of noise through the books.
